mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, conditions at Verona Community Park are clear with a temperature of 47 degrees, though it feels a bit cooler at 40 degrees.
There is no new city news or important email communication to share with residents at this time.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today. You can also catch live music at Baileys Run today or check out Paddy Macs for their music series, also happening today.
The Verona Police Department has not released any incident reports for this week.
Make sure to stop by Culver's to enjoy the Really Reese's flavor of the day while they are open until 10:30 PM tonight.
